xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4596: An ended held handoff shows 'no saved history' and hides its unsent kickoff

plan.title: An ended held handoff shows 'no saved history' and hides its unsent kickoff
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A conversation created by `pan handoff --hold` whose session ended before its kickoff was sent renders the generic orphaned state ('This conversation has no saved history…') with Resume Session and Archive. ConversationView's isOrphaned branch (ConversationPanel.tsx line 1282) never reads the held kickoff (conversations.held_kickoff), and the held-kickoff UI from PAN-4499 lives only in ComposerFooter, which is not mounted for ended rows. The pending-input feed that drives Awareness → Needs you scans only live sessions and never reports a held kickoff, so a held handoff can wait unseen for weeks (conversation 3230 waited 20 days).
narratives.Proposal: 1) The kickoff door GET also returns the handoff focus parsed from fork_request. 2) A new HeldHandoffView component renders for ended conversations whose kickoff is held: 'Held handoff — kickoff not sent', focus, working directory, handoff doc path with Open, the kickoff text behind a disclosure, Start (POSTs the existing kickoff door, which already relaunches an ended session via ensureForkSessionReady(resume=false)) and Archive, no Resume. It wins over a failed fork status (shows the error, Start retries) but not over an in-flight one. useHeldKickoff gains an enabled flag so live conversations are not polled twice. 3) The pending-input feed adds every unarchived, non-superseded held conversation (alive or ended) with heldKickoff: { since, focus? }. 4) The frontend maps that to a non-blocking heldKickoff kind in Needs you with an Open button that navigates to the conversation. 5) Docs describe both.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the live held conversation UI (composer HeldKickoffNotice).
- Handling a held conversation that is ended AND has transcript activity (out-of-band terminal input); it keeps today's timeline + Resume behavior.
- Changing pan handoff, pan handoff start, the kickoff door POST semantics, or ensureForkSessionReady.
- Making heldKickoff a blocking kind, adding toasts/desktop notifications for held kickoffs, or a Start button inside the Needs you row.
- Setting pendingInputKinds on pending-input feed rows.
- The Flywheel's own reporting of held conversations.
- Restoring or un-archiving archived held conversations (row 3230 is archived).
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap.
- Surfacing held conversations outside the newest 1000 unarchived rows returned by listConversations({ limit: 1000 }).

autoDecisions.summary: 'Kickoff not sent' is conversations.held_kickoff IS NOT NULL, not forkRequest.hold.
autoDecisions.rationale: forkRequest.hold stays true after the kickoff is sent; held_kickoff is cleared atomically on claim and restored on failure (PAN-4499 design).

autoDecisions.summary: Start reuses POST /api/conversations/:name/kickoff with an empty body via startHeldKickoff(name).
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified: the door already relaunches an ended session through ensureForkSessionReady(conv, sessionId, false) and delivers through deliverForkSeed; pan handoff start is the same call. No new spawn path.

autoDecisions.summary: The held view hides Resume Session.
autoDecisions.rationale: handleConversationResume finds no transcript, spawns fresh and sends a CONVERSATION RESUME contract as the first message, starting the agent without its brief and leaving the kickoff held.

autoDecisions.summary: The held view wins over forkStatus 'failed' and shows the error with Start to retry; ForkProgressView still wins while a Start is in flight.
autoDecisions.rationale: ForkProgressView has no retry control, so a failed Start would otherwise strand the operator with no way to send the restored kickoff.

autoDecisions.summary: Only ended conversations get the new panel view; useHeldKickoff gets an enabled flag and the panel passes enabled: !sessionAlive. For ended conversations the panel also passes pollAlways: true and gates the orphan text on a successful { held: false } lookup (plan critique round 1).
autoDecisions.rationale: Live held conversations already show the composer notice (PAN-4499); the flag avoids a second 5 s poll per open live conversation.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Brief path' is shown as the working directory plus the handoff doc path with an Open handoff doc button.
autoDecisions.rationale: The focus names a brief relative to the cwd (.pan/handoff-brief.md) and the authored handoff doc is handoffDocPath; both answer 'what was it waiting for'.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs you lists held conversations whether alive or ended, excluding archived and superseded rows.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for visibility while the kickoff waits; archived rows are deliberately dismissed and superseded /clear rows own no runtime.

autoDecisions.summary: heldKickoff is a non-blocking kind (Needs you 'Waiting' group).
autoDecisions.rationale: Nothing is stalled mid-turn; the operator deliberately held the kickoff.

autoDecisions.summary: A held-only Needs you row (kinds exactly ['heldKickoff']) gets one Open button that navigates to /conv/<name> instead of Answer; mixed rows keep Answer.
autoDecisions.rationale: requestReopen opens no dialog for a held kickoff, which is the dead-button defect PAN-3276 fixed in the sidebar.

autoDecisions.summary: Feed row since = conversation createdAt; the server adds heldKickoff: { since, focus? } and never pendingInputKinds.
autoDecisions.rationale: The hold begins at creation; the frontend's conversationKinds uses explicit pendingInputKinds verbatim and would drop other kinds on the same row.

metadata.sizeJustification: Six small vertical items across the kickoff door, the conversation panel, the pending-input feed, Needs you, and docs; files_scope stays under 25 files.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Add the pure helper heldKickoffFocus(forkRequest: string | null | undefined): string | null to src/lib/overdeck/conversation-kickoff-store.ts (JSON.parse in try/catch, return the trimmed handoffFocus string or null). In the GET handler of src/dashboard/server/routes/conversation-kickoff.ts replace `return text === null ? jsonResponse({ held: false }) : jsonResponse({ held: true, text });` with: return { held: false } when text is null, else { held: true, text, ...(focus ? { focus } : {}) } where focus = heldKickoffFocus(conv.forkRequest). Tests: store test for the helper (trimmed focus; null for null, invalid JSON, missing field, whitespace-only); route tests for GET with focus (seed via setForkRequest from conversations.ts), GET without fork_request (no focus key), and an ended-start regression pin: seed held, markConversationEnded, POST → 200, after waitForInFlightForkPipelines(0) the mocked ensureForkSessionReady was called with (objectContaining({ name }), '<name>-session', false) and deliverForkSeed received the held text.

metadata.acJustification: Five ACs: the view, Start outcomes, failure line, the enabled flag, and the lookup status/pollAlways contract the panel depends on.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/heldKickoff.tsx add focus?: string to HeldKickoff and change useHeldKickoff to (conversationName, options: { enabled?: boolean; pollAlways?: boolean } = {}). When enabled is false: { held: false }, status 'ready', no fetch, no interval. The hook also returns status: 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' — 'loading' on mount and on name/enabled change; fetchHeldKickoff returns null for non-OK, non-JSON or rejected fetches; null before any success → 'error', after a success → keep last state; refresh() re-runs the lookup (status → 'loading' only from 'error'). The 5 s interval reloads when held OR pollAlways. Existing ComposerFooter caller passes nothing and keeps today's behavior (see PRD WI-2 and Critique response). Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/HeldHandoffView.tsx with props { conversationName, kickoffText, focus?, cwd, handoffDocPath?, startError?, onStarted, onArchive? } rendering data-testid='held-handoff-view' using the command-deck.module.css empty-state classes: title 'Held handoff — kickoff not sent', a subtitle explaining pan handoff --hold and that Start relaunches an ended session, 'Focus: …' when present, 'Working directory: <cwd>', 'Handoff doc: <path>' plus an Open handoff doc button (window.open of /api/conversations/<name>/handoff-doc, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') when present, 'The last start failed: <startError>' in var(--warning) when present, <details><summary>Show the kickoff</summary><pre> with the text, and Start + Archive buttons (no Resume). Start calls startHeldKickoff(conversationName) with exactly one argument, disables itself as 'Starting…', calls onStarted on success; HeldKickoffConflictError → toast.info('This handoff was already started') then onStarted; other errors → toast.error(message, { duration: 8000 }) without onStarted.

items.title: Given props with focus, cwd, handoffDocPath and kickoffText, when HeldHandoffView renders, then it shows 'Held handoff — kickoff not sent', the focus, the cwd, the handoff doc path, the kickoff text, Start and Archive, and no element with text 'Resume'

When Start is clicked, then startHeldKickoff is called with exactly ('conv-a') and onStarted runs; a HeldKickoffConflictError shows the info toast and still calls onStarted; any other error calls toast.error and does not call onStarted

Given the first kickoff GET is pending the hook returns status 'loading'; given it answers 500 the hook returns status 'error', and refresh() after a { held: true, text } response returns held: true with status 'ready'; given pollAlways: true and a { held: false } response, advancing fake timers 5 s sends a second GET

metadata.acJustification: Six ACs: the panel branch has six distinct render states (held, Start POST, failed start, not-held/live regression, pending/failed lookup, restored hold after a failed background delivery) and each needs its own observable check.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 (revised after plan critique). In ConversationView add `const heldKickoff = useHeldKickoff(conversation.name, { enabled: !conversation.sessionAlive, pollAlways: true });`, a `kickoffStartPending` state cleared when forkStatus is set, the session is alive, the hold returns, or the conversation name changes, and predicates heldLookupPending = !sessionAlive && status 'loading', heldLookupFailed = !sessionAlive && status 'error'. Append `&& !heldLookupPending && !heldLookupFailed && !kickoffStartPending` to isOrphaned. isHeldUnsent = held && text !== undefined && !sessionAlive && !isForkInProgress && !isSpawnFailed && !isSpawning && !hasTimelineActivity. Render chain: the skeleton condition also covers heldLookupPending && !hasTimelineActivity; the isSpawning branch also covers kickoffStartPending ('Starting…'); a held branch (HeldHandoffView with startError={isForkFailed ? forkError : null} and onStarted={() => { setKickoffStartPending(true); heldKickoff.refresh(); invalidate ['conversations'] }}) sits after isSpawnFailed and before `isForking && messages.length === 0`; a lookup-failure branch ('⚠ Couldn't check whether this conversation is waiting to start', Retry → heldKickoff.refresh(), Archive) sits before isOrphaned. Tail: `{isOrphaned || isHeldUnsent || heldLookupPending || heldLookupFailed || kickoffStartPending ? null : …`. In ConversationPanel.test.tsx answer GET …/kickoff with { held: false } in defaultConversationResponse and every ended-conversation handler, then add the PRD WI-3 cases (fake timers for the 5 s poll). Implementation checkpoint (live, isolated): create a throwaway `pan handoff --hold`, stop it, press Start, confirm relaunch + kickoff as the first user turn; if it cannot run, say so in the PR body.
